description.zh: 需要查询的联系人id。多个联系人id以空格分隔。
description.en: The ID of the alert contact that you want to query. Separate multiple contact IDs with spaces.
The name of the alert contact.
The email address of the alert contact.
The number of the page to return.
The mobile number of the alert contact.
The number of alert contacts to return on each page.
Specifies whether to return redundant information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms describe-contacts --contact-name John_Doe --phone 138111100000 --email someone@example.com --page 1 --size 20 --contact-ids 123,321 --verbose true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DescribeContacts --region cn-hangzhou --Email 'someone@example.com' --Verbose true --Phone 138111100000 --Size 20 --Page 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ContactName John_Doe --ContactIds '123,321'
